## TDD checklist

- [ ] A failing test came first (or the commit says why this is pure wiring)
- [ ] Unit tests pass and the coverage gate holds
- [ ] `dotnet format` is clean and there are no new analyzer warnings
- [ ] Docs updated (PROGRESS.md, ADR, README) where relevant
- [ ] Fixtures are scrubbed (no real hosts, usernames or stream IDs)
